## Pull request overview

Adds conditional authentication support by reading server discovery info to decide whether the Console should run with full auth or auto-guest mode when `services.auth.enabled === false`.

**Changes:**
- Adds `getDiscovery()` to the ObjectStack data adapter and a `useDiscovery()` hook to expose discovery data + `isAuthEnabled`.
- Extends `AuthProvider` with `enabled={false}` to bootstrap a guest session.
- Updates Console to use a new `ConditionalAuthWrapper` and documents the behavior in `CONDITIONAL_AUTH.md`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 8 out of 8 changed files in this pull request and generated 5 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/react/src/hooks/useDiscovery.ts | New hook + `DiscoveryInfo` type for reading discovery via `SchemaRendererContext` dataSource |
| packages/react/src/hooks/index.ts | Re-exports `useDiscovery` from the hooks barrel |
| packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts | Adds `ObjectStackAdapter.getDiscovery()` (reads cached discovery from client) |
| packages/auth/src/AuthProvider.tsx | Adds `enabled` prop and guest-mode session bootstrapping |
| packages/auth/src/__tests__/AuthProvider.disabled.test.tsx | Adds tests for `enabled={false}` guest-mode behavior |
| apps/console/src/components/ConditionalAuthWrapper.tsx | New wrapper that fetches discovery and selects enabled/disabled `AuthProvider` |
| apps/console/src/App.tsx | Switches Console root auth wrapper from `AuthProvider` to `ConditionalAuthWrapper` |
| CONDITIONAL_AUTH.md | New documentation describing discovery structure, guest mode, and usage |
</details>

## Unused variable, import, function or class

Unused import beforeEach.

[Show more details](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/security/code-scanning/417)

When `enabled === false`, `isAuthenticated` is forced to `true` even before the guest `user`/`session` state is set. This can cause a transient render where `AuthGuard` treats the user as authenticated while `user` is still null (e.g., role checks are skipped because they are gated on `user`). Consider initializing guest `user`/`session` synchronously (state initializers) and deriving `isAuthenticated` from `user && session`, or keep `isLoading` true until the guest state is fully set.

Unused import: `beforeEach` is imported from `vitest` but never used in this test file. Please remove it to keep the test code clean and avoid unused-import lint/typecheck failures if enabled.
```suggestion
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
```
